verdicts.evidence: lines 537-579: search, status buttons, clear, refresh, notice dismiss, row actions (ask -> dialog -> run), retry, dismiss, reload, show more and both dialog buttons all have handlers that call the api or re-render as labelled
lines 437, 454, 510-513: rows come only from api.listInvoices and action responses; counts at 359-373 are derived from state.invoices; no hardcoded sample values or placeholder text
lines 470-487: the confirm dialog shows the invoice number, customer, amount, due date for reminders and any earlier reminder time, so the decision is not made from memory
one search input and a status filter, no multi-step entry or long free text; search and status are in any case kept in the URL (lines 224-225, 277-283)

line 493: for mark paid and send reminder the dialog focuses the confirm button, so Enter carries out an action the dialog itself calls irreversible (lines 475, 480); only delete focuses the safe button

lines 537-542: finding and filtering happen in place; lines 291-309: mark paid is a row button plus one confirm (466-494) that guards a change the api cannot reverse, which the rule's data-loss carve-out allows

lines 131-165: search, status filter, count line, table with mark paid, send reminder and delete draft map to the brief; Refresh and the extra status filters support the same list rather than adding sections; no stat cards or feeds
lines 141-155, 307: toolbar and row buttons are all plain or outlined; line 396: failed state has a single primary; lines 472, 488: dialog has one filled button and one plain

lines 96, 488: the dialog's Delete draft is a filled bold red button in the primary position beside a plain Keep draft; lines 472, 493: irreversible Mark paid and Send reminder are primary-styled, focused and triggered by Enter
lines 305-308, 383: buttons are aria-disabled only while their own row request or refresh is in flight, with a busy label; line 291: actions that do not apply to a status are not rendered
no title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script
lines 131-175, 287-289, 395-402, 474-489: all visible text is labels, counts, statuses and task messages; nothing mentions the build, the stack, the brief or simulated data
lines 475, 480-481, 486: the only caveats (cannot be changed back, cannot be recalled, reminder already sent, cannot be recovered) sit in the confirm dialog at the decision they affect
lines 131-162: heading, a field label and a group label; no sentence narrates the screen or tells the user how to use controls
line 131: h1 has no subtitle; line 135: search label has no helper text; lines 474-486: dialog body adds customer, amount and consequence rather than rewording the title
lines 131, 287-289, 368-382, 395-402: factual wording throughout, no greetings, slogans, exclamation marks or congratulations

lines 287-289, 152, 155, 396, 407, 476-489: Mark paid, Send reminder, Delete draft, Refresh, Try again, Show all invoices, Show N more, Keep draft, Cancel; no OK, Yes or Submit; status buttons are filter options under a Status label

lines 210, 262, 313-316: raw statuses are mapped to Overdue, Sent, Draft, Paid; internal ids appear only in data attributes; dates and money are formatted (240-252); the NW number is the user's invoice number

lines 395-396: 'Could not load invoices. The connection to the server dropped.' with Try again; lines 287-299: per-action messages plus 'Nothing was changed.' and Try again; line 381 refresh message; the raw ECONNRESET text is never shown
lines 287-289, 381, 395: errors use 'Could not ...' with no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals, and the subject is the problem

line 398: with zero invoices the view shows only 'There are no invoices.' with no action inside it, but the brief has no create task and Refresh stays visible (line 377); line 402 filter-empty has message and action. Two readings gave different verdicts

lines 394-402: load failure shows 'Could not load invoices...' with Try again; no data shows 'There are no invoices.'; unmatched filter or search shows 'No overdue invoices match "x".' with Show all invoices

lines 440-442, 395-396: failed load is stated in place with retry; lines 457-459, 381-382: failed refresh keeps the list and says so; lines 520-522, 296-299: failed action keeps the row, states it inline and offers Try again
lines 368, 392-393: skeleton rows and 'Loading invoices...' render before the call; lines 306, 382: busy labels on action and refresh buttons; no operation can exceed about three seconds (line 430)

lines 355, 363, 368, 392-393: while phase is loading the view is a skeleton table, the count line reads 'Loading invoices...' and filter counts are blank; empty text is reached only when phase is ready (397-402)

line 69: customer cell wraps anywhere; line 70: amounts are nowrap tabular; lines 208, 404-408: lists page at 50 with Show more; line 316: null reminderSentAt renders nothing; line 93: dialog text wraps
the screen holds no edits that wait for an explicit save; each action is sent when confirmed (lines 570-574)
line 136: the only field is a free-text search with no format constraint
line 136: one optional search field, no form with a mix of required and optional fields
no input validation exists; the search input only filters (line 537)
no form that can reject input
no form that can be rejected
no form that can reject input
no form or submit button on the screen
no form submits to the server; row actions are buttons, and line 498 ignores a second run while one is busy

lines 492, 499-500: an action click opens the dialog at once and confirming sets the busy label before the await; line 449-450 Refreshing...; line 434-435 skeleton; line 537 list filters on each keystroke

lines 513-517, 316: paid or reminded row updates in place, flashes, and is kept in the current filter (line 271); line 507: deletion removes the row and a notice names it; lines 521, 296-299: failures are stated in the row

line 507: the only visible success message is the deletion notice, which names the removed draft that is no longer on screen; mark paid and reminder use the row change itself, with only a screen-reader announcement (line 518)

lines 296-299, 381, 395: errors render in place and stay until retried or dismissed; lines 159-162, 549: the notice stays until Dismiss; nothing with an error or action is on a timer (the 1.6s timer at 517 is only a highlight)
lines 199-201: the server offers no way to unmark paid, recall a reminder or restore a deleted draft, so no action on the screen is reversible by the system

lines 485-493: 'Permanently delete draft NW-x?' with customer, amount, 'cannot be recovered', buttons Delete draft and Keep draft, focus on Keep draft; reminder dialog (479-483) names the invoice and 'cannot be recalled'; its unsafe default focus is recorded under TASK-007

lines 466-494, 567: every row action is confirmed, including Mark paid, a frequent daily action, yet the api cannot reverse it (line 199). Whether that confirmation is warranted came out differently on two readings
lines 499-514: the row only shows a busy label until the server answers; state is changed after the awaited call succeeds, so there are no optimistic updates
lines 168-176, 466-494: the only modal is a one-decision confirmation with two buttons, opened only by the user's click on a row action

lines 492-493: native dialog opened with showModal and focus set inside; Escape and Tab containment are native; line 575 visible cancel; lines 573, 576-579: focus returns to the row's button after close
lines 131-164: heading, then search and status filter, a one-line count, then the invoice table as the largest block; nothing decorative sits above it
lines 130-133: the page opens with the h1 'Invoices' followed directly by the search and filter; no hero, greeting or intro panel

lines 141-145, 363: the only summary numbers are per-status counts on the filter buttons (including Overdue, a brief task) and the result count at 371-372; line 314 days overdue per row; no stat cards or charts
lines 371, 339-344: when filtered the count line reads 'N of T invoices: overdue, matching "x"'; line 376 shows the 'Show all invoices' button beside it; line 362 marks the active status button

lines 136-161, 298-308: every control is a native button or input; busy buttons use aria-disabled so they stay focusable; the dialog is native (492); focus is restored after each re-render (347-351, 412-425, 557-563)

line 314: the red badge carries the word 'Overdue' and the days; line 53 and 362: the selected filter is bold with a heavier border and aria-pressed; lines 297, 381: red error states are full sentences

line 165 is a pre-existing role=status region used for action results, but line 151 #count ('Loading invoices...', the result count updated on each keystroke at 375) is not live, a finished load is not announced, and errors (442, 459, 522) go through polite status, not role alert
nothing expands or collapses: filter buttons are toggles with aria-pressed (line 362), the dialog is native, and there are no menus, accordions or tabs

lines 103-126: at 900px and below rows become stacked grids with a 'Due' label, the search is full width, controls are 44px high, row buttons wrap, and the dialog is capped at 100% - 32px with stacked full-width buttons
